strategic_horizon.terminal_goal: Ship WBD with exactly one long-lived public TCP-shaped 4-tuple per VPN session. FakeTCP owns the only SYN and sequence lineage; the first bounded phase carries a Firefox-120-like real TLS 1.3 authenticated bootstrap; without FIN, close, RST or another SYN the same association switches to pinned wolfSSL DTLS 1.3 -> immutable LINK/FEC/VPN datagrams. Sustained payload must never inherit ordinary kernel-TCP head-of-line blocking.

strategic_horizon.local_optimization_stop_rule: Do not return to the retired dual-public-flow Reality TCP -> close -> FakeTCP design. Keep mature FakeTCP recovery/FEC/sequence/ACK/SACK behavior frozen unless deterministic new evidence requires a change. The release target is stable 40 Mbit/s aggregate-inner on <=100 Mbit/s weak links; 60/80 Mbit are headroom characterization and fixed 20:20 intentionally expands plaintext by about 2.1x.

architecture_override.required_public_flow: Exactly one TCP-shaped 4-tuple for the whole WBD session and exactly one SYN lineage. FakeTCP owns public sequence space from SYN through teardown.
architecture_override.bootstrap_phase: A bounded reliable ordered FakeTCP setup stream carries real TLS 1.3 / Reality-like admission during the first seconds. The client is pinned to uTLS Firefox 120; only the normal 32-byte TLS 1.3 compatibility SessionID contents are replaced by the WBD route-classifier marker.
architecture_override.mode_switch: Authenticated setup switches in-band on the same FakeTCP association to DTLS/datagram mode; no FIN, RST, reconnect or new SYN at the boundary.
architecture_override.hol_rule: Reliable ordered behavior is setup-only. Post-switch payload delivery/recovery must not impose ordinary TCP cumulative-stream HOL.
architecture_override.server_port_model: The raw FakeTCP mux owns WBD sessions from the SYN. Product startup must not launch a separate public kernel-TCP Reality listener for the WBD session. Wrong-marker/non-WBD TLS-like traffic uses the mux fallback/decoy path.

validated_findings.single_flow: Automated E2E proves one public SYN lineage carries Reality-like TLS bootstrap and subsequent DTLS data on the same running FakeTCP association; wrong-marker traffic uses same-ingress fallback.
validated_findings.persona: Current client TLS persona is pinned uTLS Firefox 120. Physical Windows raw packet presentation is separately qualified as Windows-family while Linux/OpenWrt legacy packet bytes remain unchanged.
validated_findings.no_hol: A deliberate post-ready earlier sequence hole does not block a later independent DTLS datagram; steady-state is not ordinary TCP stream HOL.
validated_findings.release_point: RTT100/20% measurement-loss two-session 40M aggregate-inner with fixed 20:20 delivered 100% at 39.994 Mbit/s on the exact qualified head.
validated_findings.headroom: 60/80 Mbit fixed-20:20 points exceed the modeled 100 Mbit link after ~2.1x FEC expansion; do not retune FakeTCP core to make these oversubscribed points look like release points.
